title.zh: 双缝实验 · 一颗一颗的粒子，也走出干涉条纹
title.en: The Double-Slit Experiment · Single Particles Still Build Fringes

desc.zh: 一颗一颗发射电子，条纹自己长出来；一旦知道它走了哪条缝，条纹就消失。
desc.en: Fire particles one at a time and fringes grow by themselves; the moment you know which slit one took, the fringes vanish.
